ReleaseNotes: Added support for assigning the same Daily Assignment ticket to multiple crews or technicians while preserving independent route ownership.
Added Add Crew versus Move Here behavior when assigning a ticket that is already on another route.
Improved multi-crew write-up handling so each crew can complete its own field work while participating technicians retain the appropriate history.
Updated Dispatch Tasks to combine multiple submitted write-ups, write-up flags, Refer To selections, and closeout requirements for the same ticket.
Collapsed duplicate Dispatch closeout requirements across multiple write-ups into a single logical checklist item with ticket-wide completion enforcement.
Fixed Daily Assignment removal and Clear List behavior so removing a shared ticket from one route does not remove it from another route.
Improved Daily Assignment drag-and-drop behavior so the Add Crew or Move Here prompt no longer leaves a suspended ticket visual behind the dialog.
Added SAP Import Queue reconciliation for existing SmartGridSuite tickets, including review of tickets missing from the SAP import and controlled status changes.
